2.en:
Situation Report — Iran‑Israel‑US (last 2 hours)

  • Military / Kinetic
    • IRGC Navy: reports 11 tankers violating Hormuz passage rules caught fire since Oct 25.
    • Former US President Trump: says the US "hit Iran hard a few times" but is mostly hanging back.
    • The Atlantic (reporting Pentagon sources): a new US military campaign against Iran could last several weeks; Washington may continue a naval blockade.
  • Strait of Hormuz / Maritime
    • Multiple outlets: Iran says it has a 2‑day/48‑hour plan to reopen the Strait and resume talks if Washington accepts a seven‑point proposal.
    • Russia: hopes for soonest normalization in the Strait; says it is stepping up diplomatic efforts.
  • Diplomacy
    • Iranian official Ali Bagheri Kani met Chinese FM Wang Yi in Beijing to discuss the conflict and regional stability.
    • Russia welcomes Iran’s meeting with Mecca‑pact countries; Moscow emphasizes diplomatic normalization efforts.
    • TASS reports Tehran remains party to the NPT and claims readiness for talks with all parties while defending national security.
  • Economic / Markets
    • ADNOC CEO: international diesel inventories face a significant decline linked to the Middle East conflict.
  • Israel domestic
    • IDF ended an 11‑day operation in Hebron; residents told they may return to evacuated homes.
    • Times of Israel / AP note a Czech diplomat was killed in a Jerusalem minibus accident (incidental to conflict reporting).
  • Threat trend: Escalating — multiple indicators of maritime attacks, US officials signalling strikes and possible prolonged campaign/blockade.
  • 🟢 Good News: Iran is offering a time‑bound plan (48 hours / 2 days) to reopen the Strait and resume talks if Washington accepts.

דו"ח מצב — איראן‑ישראל‑ארה"ב (שעתיים אחרונות)

  • פעילות צבאית / קינטית
    • חיל הים של משמרות המהפכה: מדווח ש‑11 מכליות שהפרו כללי המעבר במעבר הורמוז עלו בלהבות מאז ה‑25 באוק׳.
    • טראמפ: אמר שארה"ב "פגעה קשות" באיראן כמה פעמים אך בעיקר נותרת בצד.
    • The Atlantic (מקורות בפנטגון): קמפיין צבאי אמריקאי חדש עלול להימשך מספר שבועות; יתכן המשך מצור ימי.
  • מפרץ הורמוז / ימי
    • דיווחים: איראן טוענת שיש לה תוכנית של 48 שעות/יומיים לפתוח מחדש את המצר ולחדש שיחות אם וושינגטון תקבל הצעת שבע נקודות.
    • רוסיה: מקווה להחזר מהיר של הנורמליזציה במעבר הורמוז ומדגישה הגברת המאמצים הדיפלומטיים.
  • דיפלומטיה
    • עלי באגרי קאאני נפגש עם שר החוץ הסיני וואנג יי בבייג'ינג לדון בעימות וביציבות אזורית.
    • רוסיה בירכה על מפגש איראן עם מדינות ה"מכה־פאקט" והדגישה ידיים דיפלומטיות לעצירת המתיחות.
    • TASS: טהראן נשארת צד לאמנה למניעת תפוצה (NPT) ומצהירה על נכונות לשיחות תוך הגנה על ביטחון לאומי.
  • כלכלה / שווקים
    • מנכ"ל ADNOC: מלאי דיזל עולמיים ירדו משמעותית בשל הקונפליקט במזרח התיכון.
  • פנימי ישראלי
    • צה"ל סיים מבצע בן 11 ימים בחברון; תושבים שקוימו פונו קיבלו הודעה שניתן לשוב.
    • דווח גם על הריגת דיפלומט צ׳כיה בתאונת מיניבוס בירושלים (אירוע שוליי לדיווח על הסכסוך).
  • מגמת האיום: מחריפה — מספר אינדיקטורים של התקפות ימיות והצהרות על אפשרות לפעולה אמריקאית ממושכת/מצור.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: איראן מציעה תוכנית מוגבלת בזמן (48 שעות/יומיים) לפתיחת המצר ולחידוש שיחות אם ארה"ב תקבל את הצעתה.

6.en:
Situation Report — Iran–Israel–US (last 6 hours)

  • Strikes / incidents
  • IRGC Navy reports 11 tankers violating Strait of Hormuz passage rules have caught fire since Oct 25 (TASS).
  • Al-Jawf in Yemen is a new hotspot; Saudi-led coalition intercepted a missile there (Al Jazeera).
  • Military posture & statements
  • US: President Trump said the US "hit Iran hard a few times" but mostly holds back (TASS/press reports).
  • Reporting (The Atlantic) says a new US military campaign against Iran could last several weeks; a naval blockade of Iran may continue.
  • Russia: expresses extreme concern about signals of planned new military action; says it is stepping up diplomatic efforts and welcomes Iran’s meeting with Mecca Pact countries (TASS).
  • Diplomacy
  • Iranian negotiator Ali Bagheri Kani met Chinese FM Wang Yi in Beijing to discuss the conflict and restoring regional stability.
  • Iran says a seven-point peace plan could be implemented within 48 hours if Washington accepts; Iran says it is ready for talks with all parties and will not transfer enriched uranium; Tehran remains party to the NPT (multiple reports/AP/TASS/IntelSlava).
  • AP/TASS report Iran has a 2-day plan to reopen the Strait and resume nuclear talks if conditions met.
  • Energy & economy
  • ADNOC CEO: international diesel inventories have fallen and global oil reserves dropped nearly 1 billion barrels during the crisis and closure of the Strait of Hormuz (TASS/ADNOC statements).
  • Israel & regional security
  • IDF ended an 11-day operation in Hebron; governor says evacuated residents may return (Times of Israel, local reports).
  • A Czech diplomat was killed in a Jerusalem minibus accident (Times of Israel).
  • Media / political claims
  • Multiple media and social posts allege Tucker Carlson claimed Trump could order a nuclear strike on Iran at Netanyahu's urging; reporting on Trump threatening Iran appeared in several outlets.
  • Threat trend
  • Evidence in these reports indicates an increased risk of escalation (reports of possible new US campaign, Russia alarm, continued incidents in Hormuz).
  • 🟢 Good News
  • Saudi-led coalition intercepted a missile in al-Jawf. IDF ended the Hebron operation and authorities say residents can return. Diplomatic contacts (China–Iran) and Iran’s conditional 48-hour plan offer a pathway for talks.

Situation Report — Iran–Israel–US (Mon 2026-11-02)

  • Missile intercepted: Saudi‑led coalition intercepted a missile as fighting intensified in Yemen’s al‑Jawf. Al‑Jawf reported as a new hotspot.
  • Maritime attacks / incidents: Iran’s IRGC Navy says 11 tankers violating Hormuz rules have caught fire since Oct 25. Reports link the Strait of Hormuz closure to large drops in global oil and diesel inventories.
  • US statements & possible military action: Former US President Trump said the US “hit Iran hard a few times” and threatened Iran. Media reporting (Atlantic) cites Pentagon sources that a new US military campaign against Iran could last several weeks and may include continuation of a naval blockade.
  • Diplomacy and negotiations: Iran says a seven‑point peace plan could be implemented within 48 hours if Washington accepts. Iran officials state readiness to talk with all parties. Iranian deputy met Chinese FM Wang Yi in Beijing. Russia says it welcomes Iran’s meeting with Mecca Pact countries and is stepping up diplomatic efforts to normalize the situation and the Strait of Hormuz.
  • Russia warned that signals of planned new military action against Iran are causing extreme concern.
  • Israel/Palestinian areas: IDF ended an 11‑day Hebron operation; local governor says residents cleared from homes may now return.
  • Economic impact: ADNOC CEO reports major declines in diesel and global oil reserves linked to the Middle East conflict and Strait closure.
  • Bottom line — Threat trend: Elevated. Multiple reports point to heightened risk of further military action and ongoing maritime disruption.
  • 🟢 Good News: Missile interception in al‑Jawf and IDF ended Hebron operation with residents allowed to return.
